newsitem.title: INDIA: India bullion steady on profit-taking, low buying.
newsitem.headline: India bullion steady on profit-taking, low buying.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed steady at 4,640 rupees per 10 gramme against the previous close but down 10 rupees per 10 gramme against the 4,650-rupee opening as physical demand trimmed early gains towards the close.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed steady at 54,300 rupees against the previous close but down 100 rupees against the opening level of 54,400 rupees.
** Silver (.999) closed steady at 6,725 rupees per kg amid limited activity during the day. Silver was up by 15 rupees per kg on Monday.
